items.title: Quantum trade moves beyond science fiction: AlphaCheck
items.summary: Two newly public quantum computing companies are about to report earnings. Their results will test the appetite for the budding technology that has captivated some corners of Wall Street.

items.title: Prediction: Oracle’s Growth Story Has Entered a New Era, Eyes 40% Upside
items.summary: Oracle just posted numbers that sent its backlog into record territory, yet the stock sits near a 52-week low. Whether that gap represents a generational buying opportunity or a debt-fueled trap depends on one question the market has not yet answered.

items.title: Trump lifts TikTok ban on federal devices after ownership transfer
items.summary: Investing.com -- The Trump administration removed restrictions on TikTok use on federal government devices Monday after determining the social media app no longer presents a national security threat following the transfer of its US operations to American investors.

items.title: Oracle's AI Infrastructure Surge: Smart Growth Bet or a Costlier Trap?
items.summary: ORCL's AI infrastructure bet is driving rapid cloud growth and huge contracts, but soaring spending and debt raise balance-sheet risks.

items.title: Microsoft's AI Data Center Push: Growth Engine or Capex Trap?
items.summary: MSFT's AI data center push is driving strong cloud growth, but soaring capex is testing margins, cash flow and the durability of returns.

items.title: Everpure Stock Rallies After Cloud Deal. Why It Is A 'Mic Drop Moment.'
items.summary: Everpure stock jumped following news that the data storage company has landed its second "design win" with a cloud giant.

items.title: INTC Stock Gains Overnight: Chipmaker Raising Share Sale To Over $20B?
items.summary: Intel could price the offering at around $95 per share or above, according to Bloomberg’s sources, which would be a 6.5% discount from Friday’s stock price.
